transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

Hi… thanks. I guess what’s been bothering me is that I’ve been kind of all over the place, but in a productive way? Or at least it seemed productive at first.

I’d just moved into a new apartment and was barely even settled, and then suddenly I was saying yes to mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototypes, and deciding I needed to redesign my entire portfolio. It felt like I had to fix my whole life in one sprint, if that makes sense. I know that might sound like normal ambition, and maybe it is, but it started feeling like too much.
Have you noticed any periods where your mood was unusually high, euphoric, or irritable, where you felt like you had more energy or needed less sleep than usual?

Yeah… I think so. Earlier this month I had these stretches where I felt almost electric, like really upbeat and switched on, which at first I thought was a good thing.

But then it would flip really fast. I’d get irritated over tiny things—like a contractor taking longer than expected, or my sister not responding quickly—and I’d snap like they were personally getting in my way. I’m not proud of that. It wasn’t constant, but it did feel more intense than my usual, if that makes sense.
Can you tell me how long these periods of feeling unusually upbeat or irritated lasted? Were they just brief moments, or did they last for days at a time?

Um… not just brief moments, I don’t think. I mean, some of the irritation would spike quickly, but the overall pattern has been kind of going on since I moved into the apartment—so, about a month now.

I don’t want to make it sound more dramatic than it is, but it hasn’t felt like just a bad hour here or there. It’s been this ongoing up-and-down thing for weeks, if that makes sense.
Can you describe a time when your mood was especially elevated or irritable compared to how you usually feel, and how long that lasted?

Yeah… earlier this month there was a stretch where I felt, I don’t know, almost electric? Like really upbeat and switched on, more than my normal good mood. At first I honestly thought, “Great, I’m finally getting things together.”

But then I’d get irritated really fast over things that probably weren’t a big deal. Like a contractor taking a little longer, or my sister not answering me quickly, and I’d snap like they were somehow blocking me on purpose. I know that sounds kind of unfair. It wasn’t just one moment, though—it lasted for days, sort of coming in waves.
Can you tell me if there was a time when your mood was so high or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self, and if so, how long did that last?

Yes… I think earlier this month was the clearest example. I felt kind of “electric,” like unusually upbeat and switched on, and then I’d flip into being really irritable over small things.

Like, I snapped at a contractor for taking longer than I expected, or at my sister when she didn’t respond quickly. At the time it felt like they were blocking me somehow, even though looking back, I know that’s probably not fair. It lasted for days, not just a few minutes… if that’s the kind of thing you mean.

Did there come a point during that time where your mood got so intense that you had trouble functioning normally, like at work or in your relationships, or where someone else had to step in to help you?

I mean… I was still kind of getting through things, so I don’t want to overstate it. But yes, it did start affecting stuff.

I missed a design review, which is… not like me, or at least not how I want to be seen. And I’ve been avoiding some friends and family since then because I feel embarrassed, like I’ve seemed really scattered and unreliable lately.

No one exactly had to step in and take over, but it definitely wasn’t just happening in my head, if that makes sense.
Can you confirm if there was a time when your mood was elevated or irritable for at least four days straight, where it was clearly different from your usual mood and behavior?

Yes… I think so. Earlier this month there were several days in a row where I was just not quite myself. I felt almost electric, like really upbeat and switched on, and then I’d suddenly get irritable over little things.

I snapped at a contractor and at my sister over delays that probably weren’t a big deal, but in the moment it felt like they were personally blocking me. I don’t like admitting that, because it sounds harsh, but yes, it was clearly different from how I usually am.
Can you tell me if there was a time when your mood was elevated or irritable for a full week or more, without a break?

I’m not totally sure it was a full week without any break. Earlier this month there were definitely days where I felt almost electric and really upbeat, and then I’d get irritable fast… like snapping at a contractor or my sister over tiny delays, as if they were trying to block me.

But if you mean seven straight days the whole time, I don’t want to say yes if that’s not accurate. It felt like several days, but I’m not sure about a full week.
Can you clarify if there was a time when your mood was elevated or irritable for at least four days in a row, without a break, where it was clearly different from your usual mood?

Yes… I think I can say that. Earlier this month there were at least four days where I felt really unlike myself — kind of almost electric and upbeat, and then I’d flip into being irritable over things that were probably small.

Like, I snapped at a contractor and at my sister about tiny delays, and in the moment it felt like they were personally trying to block me. I know that sounds dramatic, and I’m not proud of it, but it was noticeably different from my usual mood.

Can you confirm if there was a period where your mood was clearly different from your usual self — either unusually upbeat, irritable, or both — that lasted for at least four full days in a row without a significant break?

Yes, I think that’s fair to say. It was earlier this month, and it lasted at least four days where I really didn’t feel like my usual self.

I felt kind of… electric, like unusually upbeat and switched on, and then I’d get irritated really quickly. I snapped at a contractor and at my sister over these tiny delays, and at the time it felt like they were personally trying to block me. I know that probably sounds like I overreacted, and I’m not proud of it, but yes — it was clearly different from normal for me.

Can you tell me if there was a time when your mood was abnormally elevated or irritable for a full seven days or more without a significant break, where you felt distinctly different from your usual self?

I don’t think I can honestly say it was a full seven days, and I don’t want to overstate it.

What I do know is earlier this month I felt really unlike myself — almost electric and upbeat at times, and then I’d get irritable quickly. I snapped at a contractor and at my sister over tiny delays, like they were personally trying to block me. But for seven days straight without a real break… I’m not sure that’s accurate.

Can you confirm that during that four-day period, your mood was consistently different from your usual self — either unusually upbeat, irritable, or both — without a significant break during those days?

Yes, I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound more dramatic than it was, but for those few days I really did feel different from my normal self.

I’d feel almost electric and really upbeat, and then I’d get irritable so fast — like snapping at the contractor or my sister over small delays, as if they were somehow trying to get in my way. Looking back, that wasn’t really like me, and it didn’t feel like it fully let up during that stretch.

During that time when your mood was different, did you find yourself being more active than usual — like needing to keep moving, starting a lot of projects, or feeling restless in a way that was noticeable to others?

Yes… I mean, I think so. I was definitely more active, but it felt productive at the time, not like I was trying to be difficult or anything.

There were nights where I just couldn’t really sit still. I’d be moving furniture around, labeling storage bins, tweaking design mockups, and then just pacing through the apartment. It was like if I stopped, it felt almost impossible or wrong somehow. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
During that time when your mood was different, did you experience a period where you had increased goal-directed activity or energy nearly every day for at least four days in a row?

Yes, I think that’s fair to say. I don’t want to make it sound like I was completely out of control or anything, because at the time it felt like I was just being productive.

But I came in because I went from barely even settling into my new apartment to suddenly saying yes to mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototypes, and redesigning my whole portfolio — like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint. That was happening pretty much across those days, not just one afternoon.
Can you tell me if there was a time when your mood was clearly elevated or irritable for 7 days or more without a significant break, where you felt distinctly different from your usual self?

No… I don’t think it’s ever been seven days or more like that, at least not that I can clearly point to.

The stretch I’m thinking of was more like a few days, maybe four. I’ve had ups and downs, but I wouldn’t want to say a full week if I’m not sure. Does that answer it the way you mean?
